Playback position highlights the current genuine timed line
Lyrics interaction preserves the current native queue and track

Completed same-recording lyrics survive transient unknown duration and uploader metadata without a new fetch
Same recording reuses completed timings across measured duration jitter below2.5s
Canonical source URL reuses a completed match after alias-to-numeric-ID migration
Cancelling another lookup never deletes a completed positive recording cache
